name: Huiguan (native-place association mutual fund)
key_source: NOT CODED, AND THE BATCH CANNOT SOURCE IT. Reviewed 2026-08-19 against the whole Chinese-tradition holding of the Zotero collection 'HistorEE - huiguan, kongsi, HUF, confraternity, avarız, caravan'; not one item treats huiguan mutual aid. Zelin 2019 (the source behind shenhui_gu_alloc) mentions native-place associations once, in a footnote pointing to Rowe 1984 Hankow for 'the provision of communal social services' - and Rowe is NOT in the library. Hamilton 1977 on the Swatow Opium Guild trial, 23pp read in full, is about restraint of trade and contains no instance of burial, sickness, relief, coffin repatriation or cemetery. Wu 2025 uses native-place associations (hanghui) purely as the piaohao's multilateral punishment and information mechanism. Wei 2009 and Mokyr & Tabellini 2023 are general and secondary. THE ONE MUTUAL-AID FACT IN THE BATCH BELONGS TO A DIFFERENT BODY: Lin Yu-ju (in Zelin ed. 2015, ch.1, pp.11-26) records the Quan Jiao and Xia Jiao of Lugang jointly endowing a charitable burial ground (yizhong) at Jingyiyuan in 1775 and funding temples and a free ferry - a JIAO, and a collective good for the town rather than an indemnity to a member. NAME THE ROW'S TITLE AS A PROBLEM TOO: 'native-place association mutual fund' asserts the fund this census would code, and no source here shows one. WANTED: Rowe 1984 Hankow; Chuan Han-sheng 1986; Chiu Peng-sheng 1990; Moll-Murata 2006; Liu K.-C. 1988 'Chinese Merchant Guilds'.

name: Gongsi / kongsi (shared-profit mutual venture)
key_source: NOT CODED, AND THE ROW HAS TWO SEPARATE PROBLEMS. (i) NO SOURCE. The batch's only treatment is one background paragraph by Kwee Hui Kian (in Zelin ed. 2015, ch.4, p.79): the gongsi and other socio-religious organisations 'allowed for the pooling of capital and labour, mutual loans at low interest rates and a platform for the settlement of internal disputes among people of the same surname as well as home village and/or district'. That is a capital vehicle, a credit facility and a tribunal; no hazard is pooled and no loss is met. Her chapter contains no instance of insurance, death benefit, burial or indemnity. The specialist literature she cites - Trocki on the Ngee Heng kongsi, Yuan Bingling Chinese Democracies: A Study of the Kongsis of West Borneo, Wang Tai Peng - is ABSENT from the library. (ii) HOMONYM. gongsi is also the ordinary modern Chinese word for 'company', and it appears in this batch's bibliographies only in that sense (publisher names in Zelin 2019 nn.16-17). A census row keyed on the bare term will collect the wrong things. SETTLING THE huiguan/gongsi QUESTION PUT TO THIS BATCH: they are not one form - a native-place association in a Chinese treaty port and a shared-capital mining or planting venture in Borneo or Singapore are different institutions on every dimension the sources describe - but the batch cannot settle it on loss-mitigation grounds, because neither is documented here as a loss-mitigation institution at all.

name: Joint Hindu family (HUF)
key_source: NOT CODED, AND RECOMMENDED FOR REMOVAL FROM THIS DATASET. The BOUNDARY DOUBT already on this row - 'arguably a capital-vehicle rather than a hazard-pool; retained here provisionally, revisit once coded' - is confirmed on review of 2026-08-19, and the review is short because there is nothing to review. THE ONLY SOUTH ASIAN ITEM IN THE COLLECTION IS Wilson 1855, A Glossary of Judicial and Revenue Terms (766pp, text layer good, OCR poor). It is a colonial revenue lexicon. Its 'coparcenary' entries - some fifty of them - are about coparcenary VILLAGES, i.e. shares in land-revenue tenure, not about the joint family as an economic unit. It has no entry for Mitakshara and one incidental mention of Dayabhaga. Its entry for karta reads in full: 'an agent, a maker, one who does any thing, a husband, a proprietor, an heir, one who has inchoate rights, the active or managing member of a family' - a gloss, printed as 'KartI, KarttA' by the OCR. Nothing on liability, on the manager's exposure, on partition, on what the family bears when a venture fails. RECOMMENDATION: the HUF is a property-holding and succession institution and its comparative place is in organizational_forms beside waqf_ahli and the Chinese lineage tang - joint patrimony, restraint on partition, a managing member - not in a census of hazard pools. Retiring it here is the honest move; keeping it uncoded indefinitely lets an unfilled row stand as an implied claim that the form belongs.

name: Mahalle / köy avarız sandığı (quarter chest for the communal levy)
key_source: RENAMED AND RESCOPED 2026-08-19, AND THE OLD TITLE WAS AN ERROR OF FACT. The row read 'Avarız-hane fund (Ottoman communal levy)'. An avârız hâne is not a fund and not a levy: it is the FISCAL ACCOUNTING UNIT by which the avârız was apportioned, three to ten real households counted as one avârız hâne according to the district's wealth (Kuzucu 2016, 107, citing Tabakoğlu 2002, 672 and Sahillioğlu; Ünal 1987 works from an avârız defteri of 1056/1646 on the same basis). Antep carried 373.5 avârız hâne at ten guruş each in the early eighteenth century, rising to thirteen as the count fell. The avârız itself is an extraordinary war tax to the imperial treasury; its payers get no pool, and it is not a mitigation institution. WHAT DOES EXIST, AND WHAT THIS ROW NOW NAMES, is the mahalle or village AVARIZ SANDIĞI - the quarter chest into which successive endowments were gathered. Kars 2020 (Tarih Araştırmaları Dergisi 40/69, 160-187, 10.35239/tariharastirmalari.780977), read from İstanbul Şer'iyye Sicilleri nrs 3, 10, 12, 18, 20 and 22 covering 1618-1697, 36 funds tabulated: 'Bu vakıflar mahalle halkının katkılarıyla kurulmuş ve çeşitli vesilelerle yapılan bağışlarla zenginleştirilmiştir', and 'her mahalle paylarına düşen avarız vergisi borcu için ortak bir bütçeyle avarız vakfı kurmaktaydı'. Gürsoy 2019 (Belleten, 10.37879/belleten.2019.95) supplies the aggregation directly from the Evkaf Muhasebeciliği court, 1491-1828: 'Aynı mahallenin ihtiyaçları için birden fazla vakfedilmiş vakıflar avarız sandıklarında toplanarak gereken yerlerde kullanılmak için fon oluşturmuşlardır' - 109 waqfs in that court, 38 of them avarız, the count rising some ninety per cent between the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. THIS IS THE SPLIT CANDIDATE avariz_vakfi_kirkcesme's key_source RECORDED AS 'NOT YET EVIDENCED' - Küçük noted that avarız funds were capitalised either by wealthy donors or as an aid fund the inhabitants formed among themselves, and that the second variant would take MC1=pooling and needs its own row when a case is found. Two register series now supply it. THE ROW IS NOT A DUPLICATE OF avariz_vakfi_kirkcesme AND SEPARATES FROM IT ON SUBSTANTIVE VALUES, NOT VIA .NA: MC1 pooling against allocation, GV1 collective (trustees elected by the residents and registered by them at court, with four documented replacements) against .NR, MB3 voluntary against .NA, CN1 .NR against .NA. NOR IS IT cash_waqf, which is correctly parked as the funding INSTRUMENT whose purpose varies. PARTIAL INDEPENDENCE ONLY: both sources work Istanbul court records, different registers and different jurisdictions but one city - Kıvrım 2019 on the 17c Ayntab mahalle avarız vakıfları would give a second province and is METADATA-ONLY in the library, no attachment. Turkish-language source; reviewable in principle by the Turkish-reading PI (see avariz_vakfi_kirkcesme and logbook 5), and an early target for review_status=source-checked. SOURCING LIMIT, RECORDED 2026-08-19 (ii) AND IT IS A REAL ONE. This row was coded against Zotero collection CGNZ38XG, which the brief named. The topical collection for this form is B9Z8XKHJ, 'HistorEE - Ottoman communal funds and cash waqf', 28 items, and it was not consulted. Three of its items have since been read and two cells moved: RB3 to low on Çınar 2017's Rumelian vakfiyes and Deniz 2026's finding that roughly half of 97 sixteenth-century deeds stipulate no security at all, both showing the rehn-i kavî / kefîl-i melî wording to be a drafting formula; GV1 to medium on Yıldırım, Yeniyurt & Mete 2026, whose 1,000 Galata zimem entries of 1680-1690 show trustees and waqf employees borrowing the largest sums in the same city and decades Kars covers. PR1=0 was corroborated from both and is unchanged. EIGHT READABLE ITEMS IN B9Z8XKHJ REMAIN UNREAD and nine more are unavailable - counted, not estimated. Readable: Mandaville 1979 (canonical, tagged MC1), Çizarça 1995 (canonical, tagged RB3, OCR'd 2026-08-19), Yıldırım 2023 on borrower composition (MB1), Kaya & Akkaya 2017 on eighteenth-century operating methods, Gürsoy & Özdeğer 2022 (Balat 1555-1838), Altay & Bulut 2017 (Macedonia), Aydın 2015 (Selanik), Yıldırım et al. 2024 (Galata credit diversification). Without a usable attachment: Kıvrım 2019 on the Ayntab funds, Jennings 1973 (tagged RB3), Özcan 2003, Koyunoğlu 2008, Altay & Bulut 2024 and 2025, Yasa et al. 2026, Stefini 2024; Çizakça 1997 is a two-page excerpt. Treat every cell on this row as provisional pending that pass. PASS OVER B9Z8XKHJ, 2026-08-19 (iii), AND IT FALSIFIED THIS ROW'S ORIGINAL RATIONALE. Eight readable items were read. Only ONE of them mentions avarız at all - Çizarça 1995, 121 occurrences - which is itself the finding: Mandaville 1979, Kaya & Akkaya 2017, Altay & Bulut 2017, Aydın 2015, Yıldırım 2023, Yıldırım et al. 2024 and Gürsoy & Özdeğer 2022 are about cash waqfs generally and return zero hits on avarız, so filling this row's cells from them would have manufactured agreement exactly as the friendly_society pair warns. WHAT ÇIZARÇA DID. MC1 IS CORRECTED FROM pooling TO allocation. His Orhan Gazi mahalle accounts of 1200 AH are an avarız fund worked through line by line, and its capital grows by retained surplus and by transfers from three OTHER waqfs, not from the residents; the beneficiaries are 'the residents of a certain district' whom the founder is helping; the founders endow for status, which is why 'the enormous popularity of the avariz-nüzul waqfs among the founders'; and he puts the pooling question himself and answers that 'capital pooling was practiced only by the trustees'. THEREFORE THE SPLIT CANDIDATE avariz_vakfi_kirkcesme'S KEY_SOURCE RECORDED - an avarız fund capitalised as an aid fund the inhabitants formed among themselves, which 'would take MC1=pooling and needs its own row when a case is found' - IS NOT EVIDENCED, AND THIS ROW IS NOT THAT CASE. WHAT THE ROW NOW RESTS ON, since MC1 no longer separates it from avariz_vakfi_kirkcesme: (i) STRUCTURE - the sandık is a quarter chest AGGREGATING successive endowments, evidenced twice, by Gürsoy's 'avarız sandıklarında toplanarak' and by Çizarça's three named waqfs feeding one fund, against Kırkçeşme's single 6,280-kuruş endowment with one capital sum; (ii) GOVERNANCE - Kars's clause that the residents elect and register the mütevelli, against Kırkçeşme's .NR, though that cell is now low because two corpora show the trustee capturing the credit. boundary_basis remains structural-difference and the difference is real, but it is a difference of assembly and governance, not of mechanism. A REVIEWER MAY REASONABLY CONCLUDE THE TWO ROWS SHOULD MERGE; the case against merging is that one row is an aggregating chest and the other a single deed, and the census elsewhere treats that as two forms. THREE CELLS WERE STRENGTHENED rather than moved: DR1 by Çizarça's Table 2, which tracks named Bursa avarız-ı mahalle waqfs across 963 to 1239 AH; PR1 by his finding that rates were capped by the founder in the deed and ran below the Istanbul sarraf rate, and by Kaya & Akkaya's 81 Üsküdar accounts showing a fixed muâmele-i şer'iyye return rather than partnership; LS3's uncodeable collective liability, now attested for Bursa's own mahalles. STILL UNREAD: nothing readable in B9Z8XKHJ. Nine items lack a usable attachment, Kıvrım 2019 on Ayntab and Jennings 1973 among them, and those remain the acquisitions that would most improve this row. KIVRIM 2019 ACQUIRED AND READ 2026-08-19 (iv), AND IT IS THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL SINGLE ITEM ON THIS ROW. 16 pp., good text layer, 17c Ayntab, 92 occurrences of avarız - the second province this row has been asking for. THE HEADLINE IS A SOURCE-CRITICAL ONE. Kars 2020 and Kıvrım 2019 ARE NOT INDEPENDENT WITNESSES: the sentences this row's original pooling reading rested on appear verbatim in both with the city swapped, Kıvrım was accepted 31-12-2019 against Kars 03-10-2020, and Kars cites Kıvrım at his n.53. The peril enumeration behind HZ1 is likewise shared text. Two cells were justified on their agreement and both are corrected: MC1 to high, because the reservation the medium held open was a sentence with one origin and Kıvrım's own evidence - nine named individual donors, and a section that opens 'Bazı hayır sahipleri tarafından, kendi mahalleleri halkını avârız vergi yükünden kurtarmak için' - contradicts it; HZ1 down to medium, because its note claimed two corpora agreeing where there was one list reproduced. WHAT IS GENUINELY CORROBORATED, because the evidence differs in kind rather than being copied: GV1 back up to medium, on Kıvrım's own Ayntab court cases of residents appointing Seyyid İbrahim and Molla Ebuderda, on trustees being 'sıradan kişiler' and 'diğer alacaklılar gibi bir alacaklı' - a creditor with no privilege, one of them non-suited - and on expenditure decided 'köy veya mahalle heyetleri kararıyla'; that stands against the trustee capture Çizarça and Yıldırım document for Bursa and Galata, and the disagreement is recorded rather than resolved. MB1 confirmed as a stated norm rather than an inference: in mixed quarters the fund serves both zümre and the founder's religion 'buna tesir etmezdi'. AND THE ROW'S STRUCTURE IS NOW STATED BY ITS OWN LITERATURE, THE OTHER WAY ROUND FROM HOW THIS CENSUS READS IT: 'Vakıf gelirleri avârıza tahsis edilir, gelir yetmediği zaman verginin geri kalan kısmını mahalle halkı kendi aralarında paylaşarak öderlerdi' - the fund is allocation, and the POOLING SITS BEHIND IT in the residual tax the fund fails to cover. The pooled thing is the shortfall, not the fund, and no cell in this census can hold that. NOTHING READABLE NOW REMAINS IN B9Z8XKHJ. Eight items lack a usable attachment - Jennings 1973 (tagged RB3) is the pick of them - and Çizakça 1997 is a two-page excerpt. CROSS-CENSUS BACK-REFERENCE ADDED 2026-09-04: the same institution now carries an organizational_forms row, avariz_vakfi, scoped to the endowment of ONE FISCAL COMMUNITY UNIT rather than automatically to the mahalle - Kırkçeşme is one mahalle with one corpus, Ammu mahalle in Ayntab is nine bölük each with its own trustee and its own cash. Under a mahalle scoping that row is a sub-pool form and logbook 1's prohibition of 2026-08-31 applies to it. See logbook 2, 2026-09-04.

name: Qirāḍ / muḍāraba (loss-allocation aspect)
key_source: CROSS-REFERENCE: see organizational_forms 'qirad'. Here only its loss-allocation characteristics; LS3 not coded, it would restate AP3 there. Ramli 2018, 95-98 and 105 (analysis and partial translation of al-Sarakhsi, Kitab al-Mudarabah of al-Mabsut 22) - the doctrinal base for RB1, RB2, RB4 and PR1; Ackerman-Lieberman 2011, 663-664 for al-Nuwayri's safe-routes clause and for the Geniza documents that cut against the doctrinal coding; Harris 2007, 9-13. NOT HELD WITH TEXT and wanted: Udovitch 1970 Partnership and Profit (Zotero item RPV4XSBG is a linked-URL stub - the standard monograph for this row is NOT in the library), Udovitch 1962 and 1965, Khalilieh 2020 (saved attachment is a paywall landing page, abstract only). VF1 is .NR for exactly this reason and must not be read as a differentia against commenda_alloc. boundary_basis=contemporary-terminology IS ABOUT THE LOSS-ALLOCATION CHARACTERISTICS AND NOTHING WIDER. One real structural contrast with commenda_alloc is known and no cell in this dataset holds it: the qirad's profit ratio is negotiated and responds to market conditions and network position, splits from half-and-half to 1/20-19/20 being contemplated in the manuscripts, whereas the Genoese ratio was customary and invariant until the late thirteenth century (van Doosselaere 2009, 68, reading Udovitch 1970, 190-6). It is not a peril price, so PR1 cannot carry it. See logbook 4, 2026-08-18 (vi). Coded 2026-08-18 together with qirad_alloc, isqa_alloc and societas_maris; see logbook 2, 2026-08-18 for the inclusion decisions and logbook 4 for what the batch did to MC1 and RB4.

name: ʿIsqa (loss-allocation aspect)
key_source: CROSS-REFERENCE: see organizational_forms 'isqa' (32 rows). Here only its loss-allocation characteristics; LS3 not coded, it would restate AP3=0 there. Ackerman-Lieberman 2011, 662-664 (Maimonides, Laws of Agency and Partnership 6:1-2 and 2:3-7; BT Bava Metzia 104b behind it) - the base for RB1, RB2, RB4 and PR1. DISPUTE HELD OPEN AS A CODING, NOT RESOLVED: Ackerman-Lieberman 2011, 664 reports that Geniza legal documents for investment partnerships 'allocate both partners a share of both profits and losses, with very few documents indemnifying the active partner'. On his reading those instruments are 'isqa-shaped and Jewish law governed practice; on Udovitch's and Goitein's they are qirad in practice, in which case qirad_alloc RB2 is doctrine the documents contradict. Settling it needs Ackerman-Lieberman 2014 The Business of Identity, 2012 Commercial Forms and Legal Norms, Gamoran 2008 and Cohen 2017 - all four metadata-only in the library. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION: van Doosselaere 2009, 68 reaches the same allocation from the Genoese side and from Pryor and Udovitch rather than from the Talmud - the isqua 'suggest[s] the idea of debt, or at least equal and joint liability, which severely restricted the pairing of participants with substantial differences in wealth'. Coded 2026-08-18 together with qirad_alloc, isqa_alloc and societas_maris; see logbook 2, 2026-08-18 for the inclusion decisions and logbook 4 for what the batch did to MC1 and RB4.

name: Societas maris (the bilateral commenda; Venetian collegantia)
key_source: van Doosselaere 2009, 64-68 and 130 (Zotero V4S222VJ; PDF acquired 2026-08-18, AFTER the first pass of this row - the earlier coding was thin and medium throughout for want of it). The Genoese notarial cartularies, 6,764 commenda ties 1154-1315, 93 per cent of all coded maritime ties: p.65 states the unilateral and bilateral liability rules side by side and is the base for RB1, RB2, RB3 and RB4; pp.66-67 for PR1 (4,860 ties 1154-1265, payout invariant across destination and size). Held 2025, 22 for the Ragusan contracts sharing lucrum and damnum in the same proportions; Harris 2007, 12. STILL WANTED: Lopez & Raymond, Medieval Trade in the Mediterranean World, 174-184, where the societas maris contracts are translated (Zotero DTYK94N3 is a Semantic Scholar metadata stub, wrongly typed conferencePaper, with no text) - it would supply the quoted clause van Doosselaere paraphrases; Astuti 1970. DISSENT, RECORDED NOT RESOLVED: Pryor 1977, Luzzatto 1961, 119 and van Doosselaere 2009, 65 n.7 all hold unilateral and bilateral commenda to be 'essentially the same agreement', the choice turning on the traveller's wealth. They reach that on the PAYOUT, where the economics are identical by construction; on the LOSS they are not. This census measures the loss. NAMING, SETTLED FROM HELD 2025: the two names on this row are not two regional variants of one thing. In Venetian documents 'collegantia' is used EXCLUSIVELY for the bilateral commenda and the unilateral form has no designation at all (Held 2025, 9, after Pryor 1977, 10), so Venetian collegantia and Genoese societas maris do both name the bilateral form and the row's title is coherent. But the RAGUSAN collegantia is, on Held's conclusion, 'a local variant of the UNILATERAL commenda' - so it belongs under commenda_alloc, not here, and the split queued in logbook 2 (2026-08-16) is misfiled. Not split; see logbook 2, 2026-08-18. NOT coded in organizational_forms (0 rows there, as for mudaraba). Coded 2026-08-18 together with qirad_alloc, isqa_alloc and societas_maris; see logbook 2, 2026-08-18 for the inclusion decisions and logbook 4 for what the batch did to MC1 and RB4. VENETIAN EVIDENCE ADDED 2026-08-18 (ii), and it tightens the period. Merelo-Guervos & Molinari 2025 (10.1007/s13278-025-01460-9, open access), on 381 Venetian contracts 1073-1342 from Morozzo della Rocca & Lombardo, Lombardo & Morozzo della Rocca, Bondi Sebellico and Tiepolo, identify the bilateral form AS the societas maris - 'the merchant supplying one-third of capital with equal profit division', which is exactly van Doosselaere's Genoese rule - and report that 'by the early thirteenth century, bilateral contracts had practically disappeared', the Tiepolo Statutes of 1242 regulating only the unilateral type. That matches van Doosselaere's 'the societas disappeared in the thirteenth century' in Genoa. THE EFFECTIVE WINDOW IS THEREFORE c.1073 TO THE EARLY 13c, NOT THROUGH THE 13c, and the '10-13c' on this row is too generous at the late end where it was suspected of being too generous at the early one. Left unchanged pending the maintainer's reconciliation of the two datasets' period fields. PERIOD AND NAME RECONCILED WITH organizational_form_type.csv ON 2026-08-31, closing the item flagged there on 2026-08-18 (ii) ('loss_mitigation_type.csv still says 10-13c and the two should be reconciled at review'). PERIOD WAS '10-13c' AND BOTH ENDS OF IT WERE WRONG FOR THIS ROW'S OWN EVIDENCE. The early end: nothing on this row is tenth-century, or eleventh - van Doosselaere's Genoese cartularies open in 1154 and Held's Ragusan material is the Statute of Dubrovnik of 1272. The late end: Merelo-Guervos & Molinari 2025, on 381 Venetian contracts 1073-1342, report that 'by the early thirteenth century, bilateral contracts had practically disappeared', the Tiepolo Statutes of 1242 regulating only the unilateral type, which matches van Doosselaere's 'the societas disappeared in the thirteenth century' in Genoa. THE WINDOW NOW CARRIED IS THE RESEARCHED ONE AND IS IDENTICAL IN BOTH FILES, because period is a property of the institution and not of a coding pass. PERIOD AND EVIDENCE ARE NOT CO-EXTENSIVE ON THIS ROW, AND THAT IS THE REASON THE TWO FILES DRIFTED: the Venetian half of the window rests on Merelo-Guervos & Molinari, which is cited on the organizational row and not here, while every cell coded on THIS row rests on the Genoese half (van Doosselaere 64-68, 1154-1315) plus one Ragusan statute of 1272. A reader taking c.1073 as the start of the evidence for RB1-RB4 or PR1 would be wrong; it is the start of the evidence for the FORM. NAME was 'Societas maris / collegantia' and is aligned to the fuller organizational string, which says the same thing at greater length and is consistent with the naming determination recorded above from Held 2025. STRUCTURAL NOTE FOR WHOEVER ADDS THE NEXT CROSS-DATASET INSTITUTION: societas_maris is the ONLY code that appears verbatim in both type vocabularies. Every other institution coded in both censuses uses an '_alloc' code here whose stem lives there - commenda_alloc, qirad_alloc, isqa_alloc, ortoq_alloc, shenhui_gu_alloc - so its two rows cannot disagree, because there is only ever one row per code per file describing one aspect. The shared code is what made this drift possible, and no checker compares the two rows: check_vocabularies.py's agreement check covers the datapackage-enum duplication registered in ENUM_VOCAB, not type rows shared across two type files.

name: Ortoq (loss-allocation aspect)
key_source: CROSS-REFERENCE: see organizational_forms 'ortoq_equity' and 'ortoq_loan' (the umbrella 'ortoq' row is no longer coded). Not coded here: LR4=0 in both regimes, so there is no pooling aspect for this census to hold.

name: Caravan trade partnership
key_source: NOT CODED, AND THE OBSTACLE IS READABILITY RATHER THAN JUDGEMENT. Every source in the batch that could carry this row is unreadable, and each fails in a different way that an attachment count does not show. (i) HERZIG 1991, The Armenian Merchants of New Julfa (Oxford DPhil), the anchor: PDF present, 506 pages, ZERO characters of text across every page - a pure image scan with no OCR layer. (ii) ASLANIAN 2011, From the Indian Ocean to the Mediterranean: the only attachment is a text/html snapshot with an unresolved path; no text. (iii) LYDON 2012, On Trans-Saharan Trails: same - text/html, unresolved. (iv) 方希 2022 (tr. of Rong Xinjiang), 'Sogdian Merchants and Sogdian Culture on the Silk Road', chapter pp. 359-375: the attachment holds TWO PAGES, 359-360, breaking off mid-section. See logbook 5. WHAT IS READABLE DOES NOT SOURCE A DISTINCT FORM. Aslanian 2007 (JESHO 50, 124-171, read in full) is the Julfan commenda - enkeragir, glossed muzarba in the Astrakhan Code of Laws ch.14, with the agha/ter answering to the commendator and loss 'borne exclusively by the investor(s)'. That is commenda_alloc and qirad_alloc material, already coded, and the article does not contain the word caravan. Livšic 2008 and 2009 on the Sogdian Ancient Letters are philological. Blaydes & Paik 2021 is a quantitative political economy of route security whose 'commercial partnerships' are the ortoq, on which this census has a recorded determination not to code. Peters 2021 is an essay. STRUCTURAL WARNING FOR WHEN THE SOURCES ARE FIXED: on Aslanian's evidence the Julfan instrument is an ALLOCATION contract of the commenda family, so the likely outcome of coding it is a variant row beside commenda_alloc rather than a pooling form - in which case caravan_partnership does not belong in this census any more than ortoq_alloc does. Get Herzig OCR'd before deciding.

name: Tontine — English (Million Act 5 & 6 Will. & Mar. c. 5)
key_source: Weir 1989; Milevsky 2015 [verify]. SPLIT from the generic 'tontine' row: the type spans both values of PR1, which one row cannot hold.

name: Tontine — French royal series (fourteen age classes)
key_source: Coudy 1957 (Revue historique de droit francais et etranger 35), VERIFIED: 14 classes in five-year bands 1689, progressive interest denier 20 to denier 8; 15 classes 1696; 20 classes 1709. No mortality table existed - PR1=P, not 1.

name: Scottish Ministers' Widows' Fund
key_source: [verify]. Contemporaneous with tontine mania and actuarially priced, but loss-corresponding — the contrast case for PY0.

name: Life annuity priced on a tabulated survival function
key_source: de Witt 1671 (Waardije van Lyf-renten); Halley 1693 (Breslau table). The form that actually carries the pricing story.

name: 持寄融通社 (Mochiyori Yūtsū-sha)
key_source: 池田 2022 (規約書, primary-source edition). Functional class: 親頼母子 — a designated preferential recipient (社元 大東象五郎).

name: 宝光院加入頼母子講 (the kō joined by Hōkō-in)
key_source: 田中 2011 (宝光院文書 宝479号「頼母子連中構成書」). Functional class: 社寺頼母子講 — temple as 講元.

name: 碓井村伴吾講 (広域講)
key_source: 米谷 2026 (仕法帳, 史料1). 講元 碓井村伴吾, 大庄屋 and 代官. Allocation alternates 入札/振鬮 by round.

name: 四拾人講 (広域講)
key_source: 米谷 2026 (「四拾人講定目録」, 史料2). Allocation by 振鬮 only across 41 rounds.

name: 大満院講 (広域講)
key_source: 米谷 2026. 講元 a 子院 of 誉田八幡宮. Rules near-identical to ko_usui_bango_1822 (shared 銀預り); coded thinly on purpose — its value is the 講元 contrast, not independent structural evidence.

name: 取退き無尽 (winner released from further contribution)
key_source: 並松 2022 (京都産業大学日本文化研究所紀要 27); 中川ほか 2013 (辻六郎左衛門 無尽仕法帳, 文政7). SUPPRESSED: 大塩平八郎 investigated these from 文政12 and reported them to the 老中 in 天保元年 as 不正な無尽, on the grounds of the winner's exemption (gambling character) and 講元 returns above the shogunal interest ceiling.

name: 割地 (warichi) — periodic reallocation of arable, Iwade village
key_source: Brown 2006 (Social Science History 30:3, 10.1215/01455532-2006-004); Brown 2011 (Cultivating Commons). Received view (Furushima 1939; Aono 1982) reads warichi as spreading flood impact; Brown's regional GIS test finds hazard frequency an insufficient cause. MC1/HZ1/HZ2 held .NR pending resolution.

name: Particular average (avaria particolare) — accidental damage borne by its owner
key_source: Addobbati 2023 and Dreijer 2023, in Fusaro et al. eds., General Average and Risk Management (Palgrave). THE CENSUS'S NULL CASE: not a mitigation institution but the default rule against which the three mechanisms are defined — casum sentit dominum. Coded as the non-sharing baseline; see logbook 6.

name: 大黒屋善兵衛頼母子講 (a 領主的金融講 / 藩営頼母子, Iino domain)
key_source: 小林惟司 1986 (三田学会雑誌 79-3), read in full 2026-08-09. 長興寺村, 摂津国豊島郡. Convened by a townsman merchant on domain orders; 小林 calls it 献金講 — a donation ko. Assessment is 高割+家割 and openly regressive. NO 議定 or 仕法書 survives, only the 銀集帳, so procedural cells are capped at low/medium confidence.

name: 御殿様頼母子講 (Iino domain, 長興寺村)
key_source: 小林 1986, 296 (表1), 299, 300, 308; 小林 has a separate 1982 study of it in 生命保険文化研究所所報 60. CODED 2026-08-20, LM-0671–LM-0686. First of the three 長興寺村 associations (小林's 第一次). Nine rounds 天保14–嘉永5, 掛銀 held at 690目 for eight and jumping to 1貫400 in the last; met always in the 11th month, against the 大黒屋 kō's 4月 and 9月. Two-part tariff in 表1's own 御殿様 columns: 高石に付 1匁9分5厘–2匁8分5厘 plus a flat 家掛り on the landless in two strata (無高 3匁4分5厘→4匁0分0厘, 無高下 2匁4分0厘→2匁8分0厘). NOT COLLAPSED INTO ko_daikokuya_1848, and the grounds are 小林's: he numbers three associations, they overlapped in time (二重興行 1848–1852), the 主宰者 changed, and the landless 家掛り differs across them. But they share ~100 members and 小林 says the 銀集帳 contents and membership are 殆ど同一 — hence cooccurrence same-persons, and no independence claim may run on the trio. MB3 is .NR for no-fitting-value: 小林 poses compulsion against 農民の積極性 at 299 and argues the second side at 308, which also bears on ko_daikokuya_1848 MB3=compulsory@high.

name: 長興寺村第三次頼母子講 (掛銀675目)
key_source: 小林 1986, 299, 306, 308. CODED 2026-08-20, LM-0687–LM-0698, AND IT IS THE EMPTIEST ROW IN THE CENSUS — twelve cells, ten of them .NR. Third of the three (小林's 第三次 / 新しい頼母子). 表1's 第三次 columns are blank of everything but the header; what survives is the start (安政元), the 掛銀 675目, the 無高 家掛り risen to 1匁2分 from the 大黒屋 kō's 8分5厘, and the 無高下 share at 16 per cent. The convener is NOT named — 小林 states the change of 主宰者 for the first-to-second transition and nothing for the second-to-third — so GV1 is .NR and 大黒屋 must not be read into it. Boundary held at high: 小林 calls it 新規の講 and numbers it, and 308 puts the same individuals in all three (同一人物が前後三つの頼母子講に名をつらねて), which is also why cooccurrence_basis is raised from same-community to same-persons.

name: 二石頼母子 (丹波国山国庄, 親 井ノ本左近)
key_source: 三浦 1959 (『史林』42-6, 10.14989/shirin_42_773), 782 and n.20, from 井本家文書 in 野田只夫編『丹波国山国庄史料』. THE CENSUS'S FIRST MEDIEVAL KŌ. Contributions in RICE, not coin. Reconstructed from land-sale deeds, not from a 仕法 — nine years of members selling 先祖相伝の地 to the 衆中 and dropping out, with the land concentrating in the 親's house.

name: 「無尽」(御手洗町, 竹原屋平三郎 宅で鬮取り)
key_source: 加藤 1998, 143-145, from 「無尽連名帳」(安永2年). THE CENSUS'S FIRST COMMERCIAL PORT-TOWN KŌ. 13 口 × 1貫目; 銀高 rising 13貫→19貫; 鬮 allocation with a FIXED 500目 premium; pledges countersigned 裏印 by the 所御役人中; emergency-withdrawal clause against accumulated 掛戻銀.

name: 「銀頼母子」(御手洗町)
key_source: 加藤 1998, 146-149, from 「銀頼母子帳」(文化2年). 18 口 × 1000匁. Collateral regime is the point: 質所 verification mapped onto jurisdictions (御手洗・尾道・大小斎島 by the 御手洗御役人衆中, 津倉 from 今治), a MANDATORY 請合人 because foreclosure was slow in some places, and a no-set-off clause barring members' private dealings from the kō's accounts.

name: 久左衛門始頼母子 (朴木沢新田, 中里村)
key_source: 松永 1999 (『史料館研究紀要』30), 280-281, from 「頼母子講中極證文」(文政3年5月). 34 前 × 1分, 年2会, 34会/18年. 引取り型 with the 刎金 fixed at one quarter — ORDER RANDOM, PRICE FIXED. Convened 内證不如意ニ付 to relieve the 親.

name: 法隆寺五十貫頼母子
key_source: 三浦 1959, 781 and 790. CODED 2026-08-20, LM-0610–LM-0629. A 規式 survives with three provisions: the 落札者 owes 置銭五貫文 on drawing; the fund's stated purpose is repair and supply of the 寺用の法服楽器, and when applied to it a 起請文 must be laid before the 講衆 and the 講奉行人; new entrants must 加判 the rulebook at a 講衆集会. The 徳政 clause — 縦雖有天下一同徳政、此懸支懸銭不可有改動之儀事 — is at 790, NOT at 781; 781 carries only the 規式 provisions. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE EARLIER ANNOTATION. (i) 極楽頼母子 belongs to a DIFFERENT 法隆寺 association, the 延慶三年 (1310) 惣社明神造替 kō 三浦 discusses at 780–781 after 林屋; 経蔵修理用途 belongs to ko_furuichi_sengan. Neither is attested of the 五十貫 kō, whose declared purpose is the 法服楽器. (ii) the PDF's own OCR layer renders the winner's levy as 澱三五貫文; the page image reads 置銭五貫文. The census still has no characteristic for a hazard to the FUND, and this row is where that shows — recorded, not proposed.

name: 千貫頼母子 (奈良, 親 土豪古市氏)
key_source: 三浦 1959, 787–790, from 『大乗院寺社雑事記』. CODED 2026-08-20, LM-0630–LM-0650. 古市 かなり強制的に奈良住民に懸足させた; 落札 annually to 安養寺・万才氏・知足坊・東大寺戒壇院 and others; the 利分 divided between the declared 経蔵修理用途, 古市 and the winners — 三浦's own inference (推定しなければならず), which is why LS2 is low and analyst-imposed. 越智氏 attempted a comparable Nara kō and was blocked by 古市's monopoly of the 親 role. THE ROW'S DISTINGUISHING VALUE IS DR1=open-ended, on 三浦 at 790: かなり恒久的な性格をもち他に融資していた — the only kō in the census that is not a completed cycle, and the only one described as lending beyond its members, which is also what puts MC1=pooling at low. 三浦 at 789 makes it the 原型 of the early-modern 藩主を親とする頼母子講, i.e. of the class ko_daikokuya_1848 belongs to. That is a claim of institutional descent and is recorded as his; per CLAUDE.md it is not 'genetic', and if the resemblance holds it runs from a shared ancestral practice, which is parallelism and not convergence. NOTE ON THIS ROW'S OWN COLUMNS: cooccurrence_basis is single-valued while cooccurs_with is a list, and the two relations here are not the same relation — same-polity with ko_horyuji_50kan, claimed descent across 350 years with ko_daikokuya_1848. 'uncertain' is retained as the only cell that does not misdescribe one of them.

name: 明応七年 頼母子講掟書 (旧高野領内)
key_source: 三浦 1959, 781–782, from 「二王子神社文書」頼母子講掟書 in 『旧高野領内文書』. CODED 2026-08-20, LM-0651–LM-0670. The 掟書 is quoted in full at 781 and is the only rulebook in the Japanese block written by the members rather than for them. Arrears of 150文 must be covered by a 質 and 日状 of equal value; failing that the 座敷衆中 discipline the member and he may not take the pot; once out of the kō he receives no 合力 of any kind; and nothing may be alienated without the 衆中's leave (たのもしの衆中のくつろきなく候てハ、くたんうるへからす候). 三浦's gloss is the striking one: 村落民たることが頼母子講構成員たる資格ではなく、頼母子講構成員たることが村落民たる資格であった. THE ROW'S DISTINGUISHING VALUE IS GV1=collective — the first positive governance value on any kō row in the census. CORRECTION TO THE BATCH BRIEF: this kō carries NO 徳政 clause. The 徳政 clause belongs to ko_horyuji_50kan (三浦 790); the only other 明応 occurrence in the article, at 792, is a footnote on 鋳物師 and is unrelated. The two rows were paired on that clause in error.

name: 小三郎一分講 (頸城郡田中村)
key_source: 松永 1999, 285–286 (表四①②), from 吉川町 善徳寺文書. CODED 2026-08-20, LM-0699–LM-0719. 20 人, 年2回, 20 会, pot 5両. Drawers pay 掛金一分 plus 利息五匁 from the next round, and the collected interest is DISTRIBUTED to members who have not yet drawn on a published per-head schedule — 0.26匁 to 90匁 in ①, 0.52匁 to 110匁 in ② — which is what puts LS2=1 here against ko_hokinosawa_1820's .NR. Its own peculiarity is a subscription rate variable on demand: 講員の要求によって二倍掛、三倍掛, at rounds 1, 2 and 7 of 表四②. CORRECTION TO THE EARLIER ANNOTATION: 松永's remark that せりが行われた on the interest portion is NOT about this association. It runs from 284 to the head of 285 and concerns the 文化四年赤沢村（吉川町）茂右衛門宿頼母子, a 一両掛 / 二一人前 kō of 1807; it is also doubly hedged (らしく … かも知れない) even there. No allocation rule survives for 小三郎一分講 and PY2 is .NR. NOT ONE FORM WITH ko_hokinosawa_1820: different district, village, year and document, and 松永 contrasts the two regions explicitly at 284 (頸城郡農村には引取り型はあまりなく、返金には利子を付けて返した). But see logbook 4 — on the census's own characteristics the two rows do not differ on a single substantive value.

name: 「繁栄持寄講」(御手洗町)
key_source: 加藤 1998, 151–153, from 「繁栄持寄講銀請取通」(天保11年). CODED 2026-08-20, LM-0720–LM-0740, and it is the best-evidenced row of the batch. 19 口 held by 29 persons (twelve whole, the rest halves split two and three ways); 掛金 正金20両, 掛戻金 23両, 入札元金 380両 (=22貫800匁, more than double the other two 御手洗 kō); 入札 every 4月1日. Carries an ex-ante pledge-valuation rule: arable at the year's crop less 御年貢, the residual 作徳 set against the number of 割戻し payments, a 家質 against its own silver amount. THE ROW EARNS ITS PLACE ON PY2=auction — only the second in the census after ko_mochiyori_yutsu_1876, the first before Meiji, and it separates this association from ko_mitarai_mujin_1773 (rotation-lot) within one town and one author's hands. RB3=real-estate and NOT mixed: the clause names 田畑 and 家質 only, and the 請合人 / 受合証文 that make ko_mitarai_gin_1805 mixed are not attested here — 加藤's それほど大きなちがいはない is a general similarity remark, not evidence of that clause. 加藤 computes an internal rate of return of 1.4% to first and last drawer alike, but on the stated assumption 元銀高を全額獲得したと仮定 because the actual bid outcomes are missing, so this row cannot carry the bidding-kō transfer argument.

name: 神會股 (corporate deity association — pooling aspect)
key_source: CROSS-REFERENCE: see organizational_forms "shenhui_gu". Zelin 2019, 335-336. THE CENSUS'S FIRST FORM COMBINING A COLLECTIVE-GOOD OUTPUT WITH A TRADABLE CLAIM: rents fund a ritual banquet for all members (PY0=collective-good, as averia_pool) while the share itself is bought, inherited and sold. MC1 cannot be set — assets are pooled, no hazard is.

name: Ambachtsbus / armenbus — craft guild sickness box
key_source: Masure 2018 (10.71265/q9temk46), read in full. Mechelen, Brussels and Antwerp. Sick member notifies the busmeester, who makes a huisbezoek to establish the claim and pays a weekly sum graded by rank. Segregated fund with its own accounting and management. THE FORM THAT MOVES VF1 OFF .NA AFTER NINE CONSECUTIVE FORMS. Venue resolved: the DOI resolves to Noordbrabants Historisch Jaarboek on platform.openjournals.nl, which is open access. A full-text read had reported Tijdschrift voor Sociale en Economische Geschiedenis 15(2), 51-67; treat that as a misread of an internal reference.

name: English religious gild relief
key_source: McRee 1993 (Journal of British Studies 32:3, 195-225, 10.1086/386030), read in full, working from the returns to the royal inquiry into English gilds of 1388-89 (PRO C.47). RELIGIOUS fraternities, not craft bodies: members drawn from many trades, no industrial regulation. Relief is need-assessed and desert-assessed rather than an entitlement on a defined event, which is what separates this form from both guild boxes. NOTE THE SOURCE TYPE: the returns record what gilds PROMISED; McRee warns that leaders had reasons to shade their answers, so these codings describe normative provision and not necessarily practice.

name: Friendly society / box club
key_source: Prom 2010 (The Historian 72:4, 888-908, 10.1111/J.1540-6563.2010.00280.X), read in full from lodge minute and fines books of the Oddfellows and the Free Gardeners in Durham, Northumberland and Yorkshire. THE FORM THAT SETTLES THE VF1 QUESTION: the sick visitor is a FELLOW MEMBER and he verifies both condition and conduct, so mode and object come apart within a single form. Later than the census's centre of gravity — Prom's window is c.1870-1914 — and coded from a study of discipline, so contribution rates and actuarial structure are absent. SUPERSEDED INSTRUCTION: this row previously said Rusnock & Dietz 2012 would fill CN2 and PR1. It does not, and must not — Rusnock's societies are women's clubs of 1780-1830 and are coded separately as friendly_society_female_england. The two forms differ on CN3, PY3 and PR1, and filling one from the other would have produced that agreement by construction. Broten 2012 is still in the collection and is still the right source for PR1, being on the financial viability of these same lodges.

name: Gildebus — guild sickness, burial, old-age and widows fund
key_source: van Leeuwen 2012 (Economic History Review 65:1, 61-90, 10.1111/j.1468-0289.2011.00602.x), read in full. 225 sickness schemes extant in 1811, 150 of them guild-run; average fund age 112 years. THE SOURCE THAT FILLS HZ1, LS1 AND THE MORAL-HAZARD MATERIAL. NOT INDEPENDENT OF guild_box_brabant: Masure records that these funds appeared centuries earlier in the Southern Netherlands and flourished in the North only from the late sixteenth century, so descent from the Brabantine boxes is plausible and the two must not be counted as independent evidence.

name: Craft pensions and supply, incorporation of Mary's Chapel
key_source: Allen 2022 (Scottish Historical Review 101:2, 10.3366/shr.2022.0561), read in full from the incorporation's minutes and discharged accounts, ECA SL34. Discretionary relief on petition — quarterly pensions and one-off 'supply' — granted 'during their pleasure'. FIRST HALF OF A PAIR: Allen's argument is that the 1768 widows' fund existed to convert this into an entitlement. NOT the Scottish Ministers' Widows' Fund of 1744; that is widows_fund_scotland, which Allen only cites.

name: Widows' fund annuity scheme, incorporation of Mary's Chapel
key_source: Allen 2022, 237-239. Adopted 8 March 1768 by forty-three votes to thirteen, designed with Dr Alexander Webster, an architect of the 1744 ministers' fund. Target capital £5,500 sterling from quarterly subscriptions plus the incorporation's own funds and the deacons'; first annuities only to widows of contributors dying after Martinmas 1774; thereafter 'an equally divided portion of its annual produce'. SECOND HALF OF A PAIR — opposite values to craft_pension_edinburgh on MB3, PY1, PY3 and LS2.

name: Female friendly society
key_source: Rusnock & Dietz 2012 (Journal of Women's History 24:1, 60-85), read in full, working from thirty-nine sets of printed rules for female friendly societies, 1780-1830. CODED AS A SEPARATE FORM RATHER THAN USED TO FILL friendly_society_england's THIN CELLS, AND THE REASON MATTERS: Prom's lodges are mixed-sex or male and his window is 1870-1914, while these are women's clubs a century earlier. Filling one form's .NR from another form's source would have manufactured agreement between two populations that were never observed together. The two now separate on CN3 (P against 1), PY3 (1 against P) and PR1 (0 against P), which is the discriminant evidence that filling would have destroyed. Carries the census's first TAPERED benefit schedule and its clearest ex-ante peril pricing in a membership fund.

name: Avarız akçesi vakfı (neighbourhood fund)
key_source: Küçük 2025 (Osmanlı Medeniyeti Araştırmaları Dergisi 24, 147-183, 10.21021/osmed.1472954), read in full, from the Kırkçeşme mahallesi avarız akçesi vakıf defteri in the Milli Kütüphane manuscript collection plus the kaza's other avarız records, population registers and şer'iyye sicilleri; disbursements dated 1841. Turkish-language source. THE BLANKET CONFIDENCE CAP IMPOSED ON THIS BATCH ON 2026-08-13 IS WITHDRAWN THE SAME DAY, AND THE REASONING BEHIND IT WAS WRONG. Capping confidence because the reviewer could not read the language conflated two things: confidence records the strength of the EVIDENCE, and reviewability is a fact about the PROJECT, now carried by review_status and reviewed_by. A cell resting on an unambiguous figure is not less well evidenced because nobody has yet checked it. The confidences here were in practice set on evidential grounds and are left as they stand - the low on RB3 is a source-critical judgement about scribal formulae, not a language penalty, and GV1 is .NR because Küçük is silent, not because he is Turkish. MS reports (2026-08-13) that the Synergy team will include a PI reading Turkish and Arabic, so these rows are reviewable in principle and should be an early target for review_status=source-checked. THE FORM THAT BREAKS THE CONTRIBUTION ASSUMPTION: capitalised once at 6,280 kuruş and living on a 942 kuruş annual nema, with expenditure from principal categorically forbidden, so CN1 is .NA and MC1 is allocation rather than pooling. Perils covered run from earthquake, flood and fire to paupers' funerals, orphans' marriage portions and the tax share of the household that cannot pay. name: Cash waqf / para vakfı (parent instrument)
key_source: PARKED, NOT CODED IN THIS CENSUS, AND THE REASON IS A BOUNDARY DECISION. Deniz 2026 (10.33227/auifd.1740727), read in full on 97 sixteenth-century vakfiyes from 35 registers across Istanbul, Üsküdar, Bursa, Trabzon, Antep, Halep, Konya, Balat and Avlonya: 77 of the 97 are fully charitable, 3 are pure family endowments, the rest hybrid, and the beneficiaries named are imams, students and the poor. THE CASH WAQF IS A FUNDING VEHICLE WHOSE PURPOSE VARIES, NOT A HAZARD POOL - the same instrument endows a mosque, a lineage, or a quarter's collective obligations, and only the last is loss mitigation. Its place is organizational_forms beside waqf_khayri and waqf_ahli: endowed perpetual capital, an inalienable corpus, a mütevelli under a nazır, hereditary trusteeship, and a contested legal validity settled by Ebussuud on örf grounds against Çivizade's prohibition. OPERATING MECHANICS RECORDED HERE BECAUSE THEY BEAR ON RB3: profit rates 10 per cent in 77 per cent of deeds, none above 15 or below 10, the legal ceiling confirmed in Ebussuud's Ma'rūżāt; security either kafīl (in most deeds kafīl-i malī, a guarantor with property, materially liable rather than merely producing the debtor) or rahn (rahn-i qawī, a pledge sufficiently valuable and free of competing claims). Coded as a loss-mitigation form only through avariz_vakfi_kirkcesme, which is one. ÇİZAKÇA 1995 (JESHO 38:3, 313-354, 10.1163/1568520952600407) read in full via OCR, and it is the English-language anchor for this material. Bursa court registers 1555-1823, TRANSACTIONS RATHER THAN DEEDS, which is why it can do what the vakfiye studies cannot. Three results. (1) PERPETUITY: of 761 individually identified cash waqfs, 148 survived more than a century, a 19 per cent perpetuity rate that Çizakça calls a probable minimum; he notes the comparison Ebussuud invited, against real-estate waqfs, has never been attempted. (2) SECURITY IN PRACTICE WAS REAL ESTATE: istiğlal, the ordinary Bursa device, is a loan against a piece of real estate conveyed as a notional sale and leased back at a 'rent' of often exactly ten per cent - so the rahn/kefil formula in the deeds does not describe what actually secured the advance. (3) Bursa's own avarız-ı mahalle funds are in his dataset with capital figures across 1078-1239 AH, a longitudinal series and the obvious test of endowment erosion. Whether these waqfs lent at interest is disputed between Barkan-Ayverdi, Mandaville and Gerber against jurists who hold the historians misread the terminology; held open, not coded. PARKING CONFIRMED, NOT OVERTURNED, 2026-08-19 (iii), after a pass over collection B9Z8XKHJ. Çizarça's expenditure classification for Bursa - religion, education, social services, tax, trustees, water works, workers, family, justice including money for prisoners - is this row's own reason for being parked, quantified: the instrument's purpose varies by deed and only the avarız line is loss mitigation. Mandaville 1979 was read and adds nothing to that question; he is on the legal controversy over validity, Çivizade against Ebussuud, which this row already records, and returns zero hits on pooling, security or purpose-variation. Kaya & Akkaya 2017 settle a related dispute in the literature: on 81 Üsküdar accounts of 1784-86 the money was worked 'ortaklık yoluyla değil muâmele-i şer'iyye ile', not through mudâraba or inan partnership but by the legal device at a fixed return, so the claim that cash waqfs operated capital as partnerships does not hold for that period. That bears on organizational_forms, not here. NO ROW PROPOSED.
